get.summary: Connects as the application role and returns the server version, whether the role can change the schema, and the last migration of every module.

Returns the commit the running app was built from: its full hash, its date on master, the pull request it merged and a link to it in the repository. All are null in a local build, except perhaps the commit.

post.summary: Fetches one live results page of the source, stores it as raw data, saves new offers and updates changed ones.
Parses all stored raw pages again, oldest first, and saves the offers. Nothing is fetched.

get.summary: Returns stored offers that match all given filters, by default newest first; offers without the sorted value come last. Prices are in PLN; place and voivodeship together match offers in any of them, and so do rooms and roomsMin; district and neighborhood take ids from /places/{id}/districts (a neighborhood has a parentId): a picked district narrows its place to the picked districts and takes in its neighborhoods, a picked neighborhood narrows its district the same way, and other picked places and districts stay whole; amenities match all of them unless featureMatch is Any.

Returns how many offers each filter choice would show with the other given filters (districts: the districts and neighborhoods of the picked places by id, a district with its neighborhoods), the spread of prices and areas without the price and area bounds, and the offers first seen since each countAddedSince.
Returns the typical price, price per m², rent and area of the offers that match the filters: the median, the middle half and how many offers have the value. Money is in PLN.
Returns every amenity with its category, in display order: the same groups for every portal.
Returns every place size with the populations it covers under the configured thresholds.
Returns up to 20 places whose name or a word of it starts with the search, most listed offers first, also places without offers.
Returns one place with the number of its listed offers, also a place without offers.

Returns the districts of a place and the neighborhoods inside them (parentId is the district), most listed offers first; a district counts the offers of its neighborhoods too. Empty for a place without districts.
Returns one stored offer with its place and the nearest big cities, also a removed one.

post.summary: Starts the job in the background, or returns its run that is already queued or running.

get.summary: Returns the latest run of the job (null before the first run) and the server's current time.
